title: Require Native Service oRPC Composition
forbids: a standalone base not constructed directly by named runtime implementEffect(contract, ...), with an optional native .$context<...>() seed; standalone implementEffect authority outside root base.ts; an exported standalone service not rooted directly on the imported base; an embedded API service not rooted directly on named runtime implement(contract).$context<...>(); API implement authority outside root impl.ts; a module not rooted on the matching current-owner service branch; a root router that omits the direct Router<typeof contract, never> check, authors operations or middleware, invokes a native router builder, reconstructs initial context, or imports runtime code other than completed module routers; or a runtime namespace import from an oRPC composition vendor
why: One direct native first hop keeps contract implementation and context ownership visible without a second implementer or composition framework. Root routers compose completed module routers under one direct contract check, while module.ts attaches completed named capability middleware and may finish with one inferred inline context curation.
remediate: Construct the sole standalone implementer in base.ts with named implementEffect(contract, ...) and seed its native context there when the service declares one; derive standalone service directly from imported base plus named native middleware, construct the sole embedded API implementer in root impl.ts with named implement(contract).$context<...>(), and derive each module from its matching imported service.<module> branch. Author module capability middleware from the base-owned factory in named middleware files, attach completed named values with inferred .use(...), optionally finish module.ts with the one admitted inline additive curation, author handlers in named module router files, compose their completed exports at module/router.ts, then compose only completed module routers as export const router = { ... } satisfies Router<typeof contract, never> and infer host context at the public client/server boundary.
message: Service composition must preserve direct native ownership and the completed root contract relation.
